legal_name: A & T Stationers Private Limited (as claimed; not verified against MCA master data)
note: NOT VERIFIED - no registry data obtained. Tooling failed for this batch: DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both queries; zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com and mca.gov.in all returned HTTP 403; Bing returned only irrelevant generic results for the quoted name (no company hits); Tofler search URL returned a 404 page. Consequently no CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered state, MCA status or audited revenue could be confirmed from any public source. Per project rules nothing is invented: all registry fields and both revenue figures are null. No rejection is applied - absence of a found record is NOT evidence that the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt, so the company stays in the database pending re-check. Role is 'unknown' because no evidence of manufacturing vs trading activity was obtained (and product catalogues were out of scope for this role). Note also that the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) is inconsistent with declared HS 482010 (registers, account books, notebooks, order books, receipt books, letter pads, memorandum pads, diaries) - this is a stationery/paper product, not a construction item; per rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, but the HS code and industry classification should be corrected on re-verification. Recommended next step: re-run with working search, or query MCA master data / GST public search directly by name.
